channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: The latest: U.S. takes back Olympic women’s hockey gold medal with 2-1 OT win over Canada
item.description: Hilary Knight tied the score for Team USA with 2:04 left in the third period, and Megan Keller won it in 3-on-3 overtime to beat archrival Canada.

item.title: Former Optum employee found guilty of fraud via ‘ghost employee’ scheme
item.description: A California man was accused of hiring a friend for a fictitious position and receiving a portion of wages from the no-show job via kickbacks.

item.title: Data center in downtown Minneapolis’ Sleep Number building fuels $235M sale
item.description: The deal is even bigger than RBC Gateway’s $225 million price, when its 16 floors of new office space sold in 2023. Meanwhile, other downtown office buildings are selling at major discounts.

item.title: Mike Conley returns to Timberwolves and is OK with a reduced playing role
item.description: The man he was traded for, Ayo Dosunmu, will likely eat up most of the minutes Conley would play.

item.title: How Isle, population 800, became Minnesota’s only city to sign an agreement with ICE
item.description: The Mille Lacs Lake town stands to gain training and federal money for equipment in the deal.

item.title: ‘No losers in this situation’: Youth hockey game ends after three days in overtime
item.description: Hockey enthusiasts across Minnesota showered both teams with praise after the marathon matchup ended with 12 rounds of overtime and a shootout.

item.title: Federal judge finds DOJ lawyer in contempt amid swell of immigration cases
item.description: The lawyer acknowledged the case “slipped through the cracks” as the U.S. Attorney’s Office in Minnesota buckles under flood of immigration filings.

item.title: Twin Cities tops Winter Olympics ratings on NBC
item.description: Through Monday, the Minneapolis-St. Paul media market is tied with Milwaukee for the highest local ratings for afternoon and primetime Olympics coverage.

item.title: Minneapolis council backs off on revoking liquor licenses of hotels that housed ICE agents
item.description: A divided council approved the liquor licenses for the Canopy by Hilton and Renaissance Minneapolis Hotel.

item.title: Amid lawsuit, federal judge weighs extending protections for refugees from arrest, detainment in Minnesota
item.description: The judge’s order barring the arrest and detaining of refugees expires Feb. 25.
